payload.reason: The evidence provides multiple instances of evaluating generalization ability through experiments on various datasets and benchmarks.

claims.text: Generalization ability is verified by evaluating the model on five different benchmarks after training on Wikipedia hyperlinks.
The model consistently outperforms baselines, indicating strong generalization ability across various datasets.
Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method in terms of linking performance and generalization ability.
The NCEL model integrates local and global information to enhance generalization ability in entity linking tasks.
